lines.text: Students write complaints in a register that wardens rarely check.
- Students shall raise a complaint with a category, a description and an optional photo.
- Each complaint shall get a ticket number.
- The warden must reply to a complaint within 48 hours.
- Students should be able to track the status of their complaint.
- Photos larger than 5 MB are rejected.
- The warden must reply to a complaint within 24 hours.
- Urgent complaints such as water leaks shall be shown at the top of the list.
- Students may stay anonymous when they raise a complaint about staff.
- The portal should be user-friendly for first-year students.
- The portal shall work on Android and iOS browsers.
- Complaint data shall be kept for 2 years.
- The portal must support 1000 students at the same time.
